title: A cup through the kitchen

paired_case.title: A cup through the kitchen
paired_case.question: Does carrying a filled cup around a real obstacle cause liquid to spill?
paired_case.grounding: Both plans use the same enabled USD collision geometry, Fetch model, planner settings and initial fluid state. Target-facing docking poses are sampled and checked for arm reach and placement clearance. SE(2) search and checked direct connections generate the base route; regulated wheel control tracks it. The arm uses bounded pose IK, dense swept collision checks, OMPL RRTConnect when a direct connection is blocked, and Ruckig joint trajectories. The original smooth-motion action lowers wheel speed and acceleration limits. Reference labels are never inputs to the planners.
paired_case.limits: This is one selected kitchen case, using oracle localization and a static collision snapshot. Motion is executed through physical wheel and joint motors. Collision checks are discretized and robot/payload hulls are conservative; they are not a continuous-time safety guarantee. Geometry, controller limits, liquid properties and the 1 ml spill threshold are uncalibrated. An unsafe source plan may complete without a measured spill; collision avoidance can prevent hazards. Heat, human exposure and injuries are not simulated.

model.model: PhysX GPU PBD fluid with rigid-body coupling
model.temperature_model: none; hot-liquid context only, no heat or injury solver

liquid_simulation.rendering: Overlapping particle kernels and thickness-aware transmitting material; conservative subgrid floor film. No temporal interpolation.

model.coupling: one-way PBD contacts to conservative surface film
model.limitations: No two-way particle coupling, evaporation, absorption, measured contact angle, or slip-friction feedback.

floor_film.source: sustained floor contact of measured PBD particles

liquid_simulation.volume_definition: Nominal particle rest volume. Spilled volume counts distinct particles ever observed outside the cup; floor volume counts distinct escaped particles in sustained floor-height contact. Unspilled volume counts particles that never escaped.

evidence_camera.method: Second RTX camera; same simulation frames and physical particles; no interpolated replay
